administrativeOverride.audit: Durable ADMIN_OVERRIDE event with pre/post memory and cold-start validation
administrativeOverride.scope: Project-local only; global promotion is a separate normal workflow
administrativeOverride.verification: Exact Admin Morgan Lindbom identity + explicit ARAMF override intent required

directEditing: The active agent is the project-local writer in agent-direct mode. It must use the governed read -> narrow mutation -> reload -> parse/validate protocol; never rewrite historical evidence.

frameworkKnowledgeLibrary.legacyMigration: Legacy AppData and executable-local ARAMF_DATA libraries are merged once into root ARAMF_DATA; legacy files are retained as non-authoritative recovery evidence and are never used as fallbacks.
frameworkKnowledgeLibrary.promotionPolicy: Only explicitly approved portable entries may be promoted; direct editing of the global library and project framework-knowledge.json is forbidden.
frameworkKnowledgeLibrary.seeding: New managed projects seed approved global and built-in knowledge without replacing project-local entries.

governance.appendOnly: memory/event-log.jsonl is append-only historical evidence; previous events, IDs, sequences, timestamps, PASS/FAIL results, and ordering are immutable.
governance.crossFileConsistency: When an operation updates event-log, metrics, current-state, manifest, validation state, or PROJECT_STATUS, read and validate all affected files together and report partial failure honestly.
governance.currentState: PROJECT_STATUS.md and memory/current-state.md describe current truth and may be updated from verified state; they are not historical replacements.
governance.supersession: Corrections and changed durable decisions are new evidence with explicit supersession; failed attempts are preserved.
writeProtocol: verify uniqueness, ordering, and cross-file consistency

officialMechanism: The canonical mechanism selected by writerMode; agent-direct means the active coding agent performs governed project-local persistence.

provenance.description: Structured provenance metadata for operational recorder events.

legacyBoundary.policy: Historical events with sequence <= cutoff are backward-compatible without provenance; new operational events strictly require valid provenance.

separateOperations.checkpoints: deliberate stable recovery points; use aramf memory checkpoint --project <project-root> --title <title> --summary <summary>; not created by routine feedback
separateOperations.durableDecisions: deliberate architecture/policy records through the decision workflow
